text: Increase household access to clean cooking by increasing the use of LPG and through the adoption of improved biomass stoves.
textOriginal: Accroître l’accès des ménages à la cuisson propre par l’augmentation de l’utilisation du GPL et à travers l’adoption des foyers améliorés à biomasse.

sources.sourceText: Increase household access to clean cooking by increasing the use of LPG and through the adoption of improved biomass stoves.

text: Goal: Facilitate households' access to clean and affordable solutions; Target: Achieve 70% penetration of LPG by 2035; Benchmark: In 2012, 21% of households used LPG as an energy source, while only 1% had improved cookstoves.
textOriginal: Objectif: Faciliter l’accès des ménages auxsolutions propres et abordables; Cible: Atteindre 70 % de pénétration du GPL d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2012, 21 % des ménages utilisaient le GPL comme source d’énergie, tandisque seulement 1 % disposaient de foyers améliorés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Facilitate households' access to clean and affordable solutions; Target: Achieve 70% penetration of LPG by 2035; Benchmark: In 2012, 21% of households used LPG as an energy source, while only 1% had improved cookstoves.

text: Goal: Reduce forest pressure and CH4 emissions; CO2; Target: Achieve 25% of households using improved biomass stoves by 2035; Baseline: In 2012, only 1% of households used improved stoves.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire pression forestière et émissions CH4 ; CO2; Cible: Atteindre 25 % de ménages utilisant des foyers améliorés à biomasse d’ici 2035,; Point de référence: En 2012, seulement1% des ménages utilisaient des foyers améliorés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce forest pressure and CH4 emissions; CO2; Target: Achieve 25% of households using improved biomass stoves by 2035; Baseline: In 2012, only 1% of households used improved stoves.

text: Goal: Sustainably frame biomass energy; Target: Effective implementation by 2025; Benchmark: No text has yet been adopted.
textOriginal: Objectif: Encadrer durablement le bois- énergie; Cible: Mise en application effective en 2025; Point de référence: Aucun texte n’a encore été pris

sources.sourceText: Goal: Sustainably frame biomass energy; Target: Effective implementation by 2025; Benchmark: No text has yet been adopted.

text: Accelerate the transition to LED lighting in the residential sector
textOriginal: Accélérer la transition vers l’éclairage LED dans le secteur résidentiel

sources.sourceText: Accelerate the transition to LED lighting in the residential sector

text: Goal: Reduce energy-consuming lamps from the market; Target: Achieve 100% of inefficient lamps removed from the market in Côte d'Ivoire by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, over 70% of lamps marketed were still inefficient models.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les lampes énergivores du marché; Cible: Atteindre 100% de lampes inefficaces retirées sur le marché en Côte d’Ivoire d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, plus de 70% des lampes mises en marché étaient encore des modèles inefficaces

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce energy-consuming lamps from the market; Target: Achieve 100% of inefficient lamps removed from the market in Côte d'Ivoire by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, over 70% of lamps marketed were still inefficient models.

text: Goal: Strengthen the financial capacities of the FONAME in order to support and accelerate the implementation of policies and measures for energy efficiency contributing to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions.; Target: Provide the FONAME with at least $5,000,000 by 2035; Benchmark: The FONAME has less than 5% of the funding needs.
textOriginal: Objectif: Renforcer les capacités financières du FONAME afin de soutenir et accélérer la mise en œuvre des politiques et mesures d’efficacité énergétique contribuant à la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre.; Cible: Doter le FONAME d’au moins 5 000 000 $ d’ici2035; Point de référence: Le FONAME dispose de moins de 5% des besoins en financement

sources.sourceText: Goal: Strengthen the financial capacities of the FONAME in order to support and accelerate the implementation of policies and measures for energy efficiency contributing to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions.; Target: Provide the FONAME with at least $5,000,000 by 2035; Benchmark: The FONAME has less than 5% of the funding needs.

text: Goal: Support the acquisition of high-performance LED lighting technologies through incentive financial mechanisms; Target: Achieve 100% of households equipped with high-performance LED technology for lighting by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, there is no structured financial support mechanism (via the FONAME or otherwise) to assist households in accessing LED technologies, and initiatives remain limited, hindering their large-scale adoption.
textOriginal: Objectif: Soutenir l’acquisition de technologies d’éclairage LED performantes grâce à des mécanismes financiers incitatifs; Cible: Atteindre 100 % de ménages équipés technologie LED pour l’éclairageperformants d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, il n’existe pas de mécanisme structuré d’accompagnement financier (via le FONAME ou autre) pour soutenir l’accès des ménages aux technologies LED, et les initiatives restent limitées, ce qui freine leur adoption à grande échelle

sources.sourceText: Goal: Support the acquisition of high-performance LED lighting technologies through incentive financial mechanisms; Target: Achieve 100% of households equipped with high-performance LED technology for lighting by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, there is no structured financial support mechanism (via the FONAME or otherwise) to assist households in accessing LED technologies, and initiatives remain limited, hindering their large-scale adoption.

text: Strengthening energy efficiency in the residential sector (household appliances)
textOriginal: Renforcer l’efficacité énergétique dans le résidentiel (équipements électroménagers)

sources.sourceText: Strengthening energy efficiency in the residential sector (household appliances)

text: Goal: Reduce energy-intensive household appliances on the market; Target: 100% of household appliances marketed compliant with MEPS and energy labeling by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, the vast majority of household appliances marketed in Côte d'Ivoire were inefficient and not subject to energy labeling, with the regulation (Decree 140/2020) just having been adopted.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les appareils électroménagers énergivores du marché; Cible: 100 % des appareils électroménagers mis en marché conformes aux MEPS et à l’étiquetage énergétiqued’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, la grande majorité des appareils électroménagers mis en marché enCôte d’Ivoire étaient inefficaces et non soumis à l’étiquetage énergétique, la réglementation (Arrêté 140/2020) venant toutjuste d’être adoptée

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce energy-intensive household appliances on the market; Target: 100% of household appliances marketed compliant with MEPS and energy labeling by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, the vast majority of household appliances marketed in Côte d'Ivoire were inefficient and not subject to energy labeling, with the regulation (Decree 140/2020) just having been adopted.

text: Goal: Support the acquisition of efficient household appliances; Target: Reach at least 70% of beneficiary households by 2035 through accompanying mechanisms via FONAME subsidies; Benchmark: In 2020, 0% of households benefited from accompanying mechanisms for the purchase of efficient household appliances, as the system was not yet operational.
textOriginal: Objectif: Soutenir l’acquisition d’appareils électroménagers performants; Cible: Atteindre au moins 70 % des ménages bénéficiaires d’ici 2035 grâce aux mécanismes d’accompagnement via les subventions FONAME; Point de référence: En 2020, 0%des ménages bénéficiaient de mécanismes d’accompagnement pour l’achat d’appareils électroménagers performants, car le dispositif n’était pas encore opérationnel

sources.sourceText: Goal: Support the acquisition of efficient household appliances; Target: Reach at least 70% of beneficiary households by 2035 through accompanying mechanisms via FONAME subsidies; Benchmark: In 2020, 0% of households benefited from accompanying mechanisms for the purchase of efficient household appliances, as the system was not yet operational.

text: Strengthen energy efficiency practices in the public and commercial sectors.
textOriginal: Renforcer les pratiques d’efficacité énergétique dans le secteur public et commercial

sources.sourceText: Strengthen energy efficiency practices in the public and commercial sectors.

text: Goal: Identify the potential for energy savings; Target: 100% of public and commercial buildings will have conducted periodic energy audits in compliance with regulations by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of public and commercial buildings in Côte d'Ivoire had conducted periodic energy audits, with the mechanism still being poorly implemented and little known.
textOriginal: Objectif: Identifier le potentiel d’économies d’énergie; Cible: 100 % des bâtiments publics et commerciaux auront réalisé des audits énergétiques périodiques conformes à la réglementationd’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 10 % desbâtiments publics et commerciaux en Côte d’Ivoire avaient réalisé desaudits énergétiques périodiques, le dispositif étant encore peu appliqué et peu connu

sources.sourceText: Goal: Identify the potential for energy savings; Target: 100% of public and commercial buildings will have conducted periodic energy audits in compliance with regulations by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of public and commercial buildings in Côte d'Ivoire had conducted periodic energy audits, with the mechanism still being poorly implemented and little known.

text: Goal: Improve the energy performance of 10 public administrative buildings; Target: 10 public buildings effectively rehabilitated; Benchmark: In 2020, no building had undergone an energy audit in accordance with national provisions making such audits mandatory.
textOriginal: Objectif: Améliorer la performance énergétique de 10 bâtiments administratifs assujettis; Cible: 10 Bâtiments publics réhabilités de manière efficace; Point de référence: En 2020, aucun bâtiment n’avait fait l’objet d’un audit énergétique conformément aux dispositions nationales rendantcet audit obligatoire.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Improve the energy performance of 10 public administrative buildings; Target: 10 public buildings effectively rehabilitated; Benchmark: In 2020, no building had undergone an energy audit in accordance with national provisions making such audits mandatory.

text: Goal: Reduce consumption in public services and businesses; Target: Reduce the energy intensity of the tertiary sector by 30% by 2035; Benchmark: Average sector consumption (2020)
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les consommations dans les services publics et commerces; Cible: Réduire de 30 % l’intensité énergétique du secteur tertiaire d’ici 2035; Point de référence: Consommations moyennes secteur (2020)

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce consumption in public services and businesses; Target: Reduce the energy intensity of the tertiary sector by 30% by 2035; Benchmark: Average sector consumption (2020)

text: Goal: 78% reduction in the energy intensity of public lighting by 2035 (corresponding to 100% use of energy-efficient lamps); Target: Reduce the energy intensity of public lighting by 78% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, public lighting was primarily provided by high-pressure sodium lamps (HPS).
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduction de 78% de l’intensité énergétique de l’éclairagepublic d’ici 2035 (correspondant à 100% d’utilisation des lampes basse consommation); Cible: Réduire de 78 % l’intensité énergétique de l’éclairage public d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, l’éclairage public était principalement assuré par des lampes à sodium haute pression (SHP)

sources.sourceText: Goal: 78% reduction in the energy intensity of public lighting by 2035 (corresponding to 100% use of energy-efficient lamps); Target: Reduce the energy intensity of public lighting by 78% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, public lighting was primarily provided by high-pressure sodium lamps (HPS).

text: Goal: Promote Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) that guarantee measurable reductions in energy consumption.; Target: Develop and implement at least 40 Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) by 2035.; Baseline: In 2023, no Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) had yet been implemented in the targeted buildings and sectors, and no measurable reduction in energy consumption had been recorded in this regard.
textOriginal: Objectif: Promouvoir les Contrats de Performance Énergétique (CPE) garantissantdes réductions mesurables de consommation énergétique.; Cible: Élaborer et mettre en œuvre au moins 40 Contrats de PerformanceÉnergétique (CPE) d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2023, aucun Contrat de Performance Énergétique (CPE) n’était encore mis en œuvre dans les bâtiments et secteurs ciblés, et aucune réduction mesurable de la consommationénergétique n’avait été enregistrée à ce titre.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Promote Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) that guarantee measurable reductions in energy consumption.; Target: Develop and implement at least 40 Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) by 2035.; Baseline: In 2023, no Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) had yet been implemented in the targeted buildings and sectors, and no measurable reduction in energy consumption had been recorded in this regard.

text: Develop energy efficiency in the industrial sector
textOriginal: Développer l’efficacité énergétique dans le secteur industriel

sources.sourceText: Develop energy efficiency in the industrial sector

text: Goal: Identify and leverage the potential for energy savings in industrial sites; Target: Achieve 100% of audited industrial sites by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, less than 10% of industrial sites had been audited.
textOriginal: Objectif: Identifier et exploiter le potentiel d’économies d’énergie dans les sites industriels; Cible: Atteindre 100 % de sites industriels audités d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2023, moins de 10% des sites industriels avaient été audités

sources.sourceText: Goal: Identify and leverage the potential for energy savings in industrial sites; Target: Achieve 100% of audited industrial sites by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, less than 10% of industrial sites had been audited.

text: Goal: Support the acquisition of modern low-energy equipment in industrial processes; Target: Reduce the average energy intensity of the industrial sector by less than 30% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, the average energy intensity of the industrial sector had only been reduced by less than 5%.
textOriginal: Objectif: Soutenir l’acquisition d’équipements modernes à faible intensité énergétique dans les procédés industriels; Cible: Réduire moins de 30 % l’intensité énergétique moyenne du secteur industriel d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2023, l’intensité énergétique moyenne du secteur industriel n’avait été réduite que de moins de 5%

sources.sourceText: Goal: Support the acquisition of modern low-energy equipment in industrial processes; Target: Reduce the average energy intensity of the industrial sector by less than 30% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, the average energy intensity of the industrial sector had only been reduced by less than 5%.

text: Goal: Promote the adoption and implementation of energy management systems compliant with ISO 50001 standards within large industries; Target: Achieve 20% of industries with an operational energy management system by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 1% of sites were certified.
textOriginal: Objectif: Favoriser l’adoption et la mise en œuvre des systèmes de management de l’énergie conformes à la norme ISO 50001 au sein des grandes industries; Cible: Atteindre 20 % des industries avec un système de managementd’énergie opérationnel d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 1% des sites étaientcertifiés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Promote the adoption and implementation of energy management systems compliant with ISO 50001 standards within large industries; Target: Achieve 20% of industries with an operational energy management system by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 1% of sites were certified.

text: Gradually eliminate fugitive methane emissions in oil and gas operations.
textOriginal: Éliminer progressivement les émissions fugitives de méthanes dans les opérations pétrolières et gazières.

sources.sourceText: Gradually eliminate fugitive methane emissions in oil and gas operations.

text: Goal: Assess and reduce fugitive methane emissions levels in the hydrocarbons sector in Côte d'Ivoire.; Target: Conduct a comprehensive mapping of potential emission sites; Baseline: As of 2023, no site has been inventoried, and no emission source has been identified at the national level. Absence of a centralized database on fugitive emission sources.
textOriginal: Objectif: Evaluer et réduire les niveaux d’émissions fugitives de méthane dans le secteur des hydrocarbures en Côte d’Ivoire.; Cible: Faire une cartographie complète des sites potentiels d’émission; Point de référence: En 2023, Aucun site n’a été inventorié, aucune source d’émission n’a été identifiée au niveau national.Absence de base de données centralisée sur les sources d’émissions fugitives.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Assess and reduce fugitive methane emissions levels in the hydrocarbons sector in Côte d'Ivoire.; Target: Conduct a comprehensive mapping of potential emission sites; Baseline: As of 2023, no site has been inventoried, and no emission source has been identified at the national level. Absence of a centralized database on fugitive emission sources.

text: Goal: Accurately quantify fugitive methane emissions at identified sites using high-precision measurement devices, in accordance with recognized international standards.; Target: Achieve 100% of production, transport, and storage sites assessed by 2035.; Baseline: In 2024, no national campaign for quantifying fugitive methane emissions. However, initial detection and quantification campaigns conducted by some operators.
textOriginal: Objectif: Quantifier avec précision les émissions fugitives de méthane sur les sites identifiés en utilisant desappareils de mesure de haute précision, conformémentaux normes internationales reconnues.; Cible: Atteindre 100 % de sites de production, de transport et stockage évalués d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2024, Aucune campagne nationale de quantification des émissions fugitives de méthane. Par contre, les premières campagnes de détection et de quantification menées par certains opérateurs.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Accurately quantify fugitive methane emissions at identified sites using high-precision measurement devices, in accordance with recognized international standards.; Target: Achieve 100% of production, transport, and storage sites assessed by 2035.; Baseline: In 2024, no national campaign for quantifying fugitive methane emissions. However, initial detection and quantification campaigns conducted by some operators.

text: Goal: Establish a reliable and up-to-date database of fugitive methane emissions to enhance transparency and improve environmental management of the affected sites.; Target: Comprehensive assessment of methane emissions in the hydrocarbons sector; Benchmark: To date, absence of an official report at the national level.
textOriginal: Objectif: Établir une base de données fiable et actualisée des émissions fugitives de méthanepour renforcer la transparence et améliorer la gestion environnementale des sites concernés.; Cible: Evaluation complète des émissions de méthanes dansle secteur deshydrocarbures; Point de référence: A ce jour, Absence de rapport officiel au niveau national.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Establish a reliable and up-to-date database of fugitive methane emissions to enhance transparency and improve environmental management of the affected sites.; Target: Comprehensive assessment of methane emissions in the hydrocarbons sector; Benchmark: To date, absence of an official report at the national level.

text: Modernize the charcoal supply chain by adopting high-efficiency carbonization processes and structuring value chains.
textOriginal: Moderniser la filière charbon de bois par l’adoption de procédés de carbonisation à haute efficacité énergétique et la structuration des chaînes de valeur

sources.sourceText: Modernize the charcoal supply chain by adopting high-efficiency carbonization processes and structuring value chains.

text: Goal: Increase the share of national charcoal production achieved with improved carbonization techniques; Target: Achieve at least 45% of national charcoal production from improved kilns by 2030; Baseline: In 2024, approximately 10% of national charcoal production in Côte d'Ivoire was achieved using improved kilns.
textOriginal: Objectif: Accroitre la part de la production nationale de charbon réalisée avec des techniques améliorées de carbonisation; Cible: Atteindre au moins 45% de la production nationale de charbon de bois réalisée avec des meules fours améliorés d’ici 2030; Point de référence: En 2024, environ 10% de la production nationale de charbon de bois en Côte d’Ivoire était réalisée à l’aidede meules fours améliorés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase the share of national charcoal production achieved with improved carbonization techniques; Target: Achieve at least 45% of national charcoal production from improved kilns by 2030; Baseline: In 2024, approximately 10% of national charcoal production in Côte d'Ivoire was achieved using improved kilns.

text: Goal: Support the dissemination of energy efficiency technologies by accompanying the implementation of pilot programs and mobilizing support from Non-Governmental Organizations and local organizations, in order to promote their adoption on a larger scale; Target: Achieve at least 45% of national charcoal production carried out with improved kilns by 2031; Benchmark: In 2024, approximately 10% of national charcoal production in Côte d'Ivoire was carried out using improved kilns.
textOriginal: Objectif: Soutenir la diffusion des technologies d’efficacité énergétique en accompagnant la mise en œuvre de programmes pilotes et en mobilisant l’appui d’ONG et d’organisations locales, afin de favoriser leur adoption à plus grande échelle; Cible: Atteindre au moins 45% de la production nationale de charbon de bois réalisée avec des fours améliorés d’ici 2031; Point de référence: En 2024, environ 10% de la production nationale de charbon de bois en Côte d’Ivoire était réalisée à l’aidede meules fours améliorés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Support the dissemination of energy efficiency technologies by accompanying the implementation of pilot programs and mobilizing support from Non-Governmental Organizations and local organizations, in order to promote their adoption on a larger scale; Target: Achieve at least 45% of national charcoal production carried out with improved kilns by 2031; Benchmark: In 2024, approximately 10% of national charcoal production in Côte d'Ivoire was carried out using improved kilns.

text: Goal: Strengthen the governance and sustainability of the wood-energy sector by organizing producers into cooperatives and establishing a quality certification mechanism; Target: Achieve at least 50% of wood-energy producers organized into cooperatives and certified by 2035; Baseline: In 2024, less than 5% of wood-energy producers were organized into cooperatives and certified.
textOriginal: Objectif: Renforcer la gouvernance et la durabilité de lafilière bois-énergie en organisant les producteurs en coopératives et en instaurant un mécanisme decertification qualité; Cible: Atteindre au moins 50 % des producteurs de bois-énergie organisés en coopératives et certifiés d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2024, moins de 5% des producteurs de bois-énergie étaient organisés en coopérativeset certifiés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Strengthen the governance and sustainability of the wood-energy sector by organizing producers into cooperatives and establishing a quality certification mechanism; Target: Achieve at least 50% of wood-energy producers organized into cooperatives and certified by 2035; Baseline: In 2024, less than 5% of wood-energy producers were organized into cooperatives and certified.

text: Increase the share of renewable energies (solar, biomass, hydropower, wind) to 46.3% in the national electricity mix by 2035.
textOriginal: Porter la part des énergies renouvelables (solaire, biomasse, hydroélectricité, éolien) à 46,3% dans le mix électrique national d’ici 2035

sources.sourceText: Increase the share of renewable energies (solar, biomass, hydropower, wind) to 46.3% in the national electricity mix by 2035.

text: Goal: Increase solar capacity; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 1074 Megawatts in photovoltaic solar energy by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, the installed capacity in photovoltaic solar energy in Côte d'Ivoire was estimated to be less than 1 Megawatt.
textOriginal: Objectif: Augmenter capacité solaire; Cible: Atteindre une capacité installée de 1074 MW en énergie solaire photovoltaïque d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, la capacité installée en énergie solaire photovoltaïqueen Côte d’Ivoire était estimée à moins de 1 MW

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase solar capacity; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 1074 Megawatts in photovoltaic solar energy by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, the installed capacity in photovoltaic solar energy in Côte d'Ivoire was estimated to be less than 1 Megawatt.

text: Goal: Increase solar capacity; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 1299 Megawatts of photovoltaic solar capacity by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, the installed capacity of photovoltaic solar energy in Côte d'Ivoire was estimated to be less than 1 Megawatt.
textOriginal: Objectif: Augmenter capacité solaire; Cible: Atteindre une capacité de 1299 MW de capacité installée en solaire photovoltaïque d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, la capacité installée enénergie solaire photovoltaïque en Côte d’Ivoire était estimée à moins de 1 MW

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase solar capacity; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 1299 Megawatts of photovoltaic solar capacity by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, the installed capacity of photovoltaic solar energy in Côte d'Ivoire was estimated to be less than 1 Megawatt.

text: Goal: Reduce emissions from the industrial sector by using solar energy for self-consumption, while increasing the share of renewable energies in national energy consumption; Target: Add 1031 Megawatts of self-consumed PV capacity from businesses and industries; Benchmark: In 2020, no self-consumed photovoltaic capacity was reported in the commerce and industry sectors.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les émissions du secteur industriel par le recours à l’énergie solaire en autoconsommation, tout en augmentant la part des énergies renouvelables dans la consommation énergétique nationale; Cible: Ajouter 1031 MW de capacité PV enautoconsommation des commerces et industries; Point de référence: En 2020, aucune capacité solaire photovoltaïque en autoconsommation n’était déclarée dans les secteurs du commerce et de l’industrie.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce emissions from the industrial sector by using solar energy for self-consumption, while increasing the share of renewable energies in national energy consumption; Target: Add 1031 Megawatts of self-consumed PV capacity from businesses and industries; Benchmark: In 2020, no self-consumed photovoltaic capacity was reported in the commerce and industry sectors.

text: Goal: Increase the electricity production capacity from renewable sources by installing 150 Megawatts of wind power by 2035, in order to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the energy sector and diversify the national electricity mix; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 150 MW in wind energy by 2035; Benchmark: In 2025, no installed wind capacity is recorded in the national electricity mix.
textOriginal: Objectif: Accroître la capacité de production d’électricité àpartir de sources renouvelables en installant 150 MW de puissance éolienne d’ici 2035, afin de réduire les émissions de gaz à effet de serre du secteur de l’énergie, diversifier le mix électrique national; Cible: Atteindre une capacité installée de 150 MWen énergie éolienne d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2025, aucune capacité éolienne installée n’est recensée dans le mix électrique national

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase the electricity production capacity from renewable sources by installing 150 Megawatts of wind power by 2035, in order to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the energy sector and diversify the national electricity mix; Target: Achieve an installed capacity of 150 MW in wind energy by 2035; Benchmark: In 2025, no installed wind capacity is recorded in the national electricity mix.

text: Goal: Enhance local biomass resources by installing 122 Megawatts of electricity generation capacity from biomass by 2035; Target: Achieve 122 Megawatts of installed capacity in biomass power plants by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, no electricity generation facilities from biomass were operational.
textOriginal: Objectif: Valoriser les ressources biomasse locales en installant 122 MW de capacité de production d’électricité à partir de la biomasse d’ici 2035; Cible: Atteindre 122 MW de capacité installée en centrales biomasse d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, aucune installation de production d’électricité à partir de la biomasse n’était opérationnelle.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Enhance local biomass resources by installing 122 Megawatts of electricity generation capacity from biomass by 2035; Target: Achieve 122 Megawatts of installed capacity in biomass power plants by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, no electricity generation facilities from biomass were operational.

text: Goal: Increase the energy valorization of agricultural and forestry residues; Target: Achieve 199 Megawatts of installed capacity in biomass power plants by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, no electricity production capacity from biomass was installed.
textOriginal: Objectif: Accroître la valorisation énergétique des résidus agricoles et forestiers; Cible: Atteindre 199 MW de capacité installée en centrales biomasse d’ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, aucune capacité de production d’électricité à partir de la biomasse n’était installée

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase the energy valorization of agricultural and forestry residues; Target: Achieve 199 Megawatts of installed capacity in biomass power plants by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, no electricity production capacity from biomass was installed.

text: Goal: Increase national electricity production capacity; Target: Achieve 1,818 Megawatts by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, 604 MW of hydropower capacity was installed.
textOriginal: Objectif: Accroître la capacité nationale de production d’électricité; Cible: Atteindre 1 818 MW àl’horizon 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, 604MW de capacité hydroélectrique étaient installés

sources.sourceText: Goal: Increase national electricity production capacity; Target: Achieve 1,818 Megawatts by 2035; Benchmark: In 2020, 604 MW of hydropower capacity was installed.

text: Goal: Strengthen inclusive and sustainable land tenure security mechanisms to promote agroforestry investments, circular land management, ecosystem regeneration, and climate resilience of territories; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 28% of rural areas by sustainable land tenure security arrangements by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, approximately 18% of rural areas benefit from a formal or community land tenure security arrangement.
textOriginal: Objectif: Renforcer les mécanismes de sécurisation foncière inclusifs et durables pour favoriser les investissements agroforestiers, la gestion circulaire des terres, la régénération des écosystèmes et la résilience climatique des territoires; Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 28 % des zones rurales par des dispositifs de sécurisation foncière durable d'ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, environ 18% des zones rurales bénéficient d'un dispositif formel ou communautaire de sécurisation foncière.

text: Goal: Combat illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing (IUU) in order to prevent overexploitation and promote the regeneration of aquatic ecosystems; Target: By 2035, 80% of targeted marine and freshwater fishing areas must be covered by an operational fisheries monitoring and control system.; Baseline: In 2023, approximately 20% of fishing areas have a structured scientific monitoring and regular stock control system. Existence of a Fisheries Control, Monitoring and Surveillance (CMS) system at the maritime level since 2020.
textOriginal: Objectif: Lutter contre la pêche illégale, non déclarée et non réglementée (INN) afin de prévenir la surexploitation et favoriser la régénération des écosystèmes aquatiques; Cible: D'ici 2035, 80% des zones de pêche marines et continentales ciblées devront être couvertes par un système opérationnel de suivi et de contrôle des pêches.; Point de référence: En 2023, environ 20% des zones de pêche disposent d’un système structuré de suivi scientifique et de contrôle régulier des stocks. Existence d’un système de Contrôle, Suivi et Surveillance des pêches (CSS) au niveau maritime, depuis 2020.

text: Goal: Ensure sustainable and equitable management of fishery resources to preserve stocks, strengthen local governance, and improve livelihoods while integrating the principles of the circular economy; Target: Achieve an implementation rate of at least 75% of the measures outlined in the participatory fisheries management plans adopted by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 20% of the measures outlined in the adopted participatory fisheries management plans are effectively implemented.
textOriginal: Objectif: Garantir une gestion durable et équitable des ressources halieutiques afin de préserver les stocks, renforcer la gouvernance locale et améliorer les moyens de subsistance en veillant à intégrer les principes de l’économie circulaire; Cible: Atteindre un taux de mise en œuvre d’au moins 75% des mesures prévues dans les plans d’aménagement participatif des pêcheries adoptés d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 20% des mesures prévues dans les plans d’aménagement participatif des pêcheries adoptés sont effectivement mises en œuvre

textOriginal: Objectif: Assurer la durabilité de la pêche et la conservation de la biodiversité.; Cible: D’ici 2035, 50 000 hectares d’aires marines et continentales protégées devront être créés, équipés et gérés durablement.; Point de référence: En 2023, environ 5000 hectares d’aires protégées étaient dédiés spécifiquement à la reproduction et au repeuplement des espèces aquatiques

text: Goal: Preserve the integrity of forest masses by improving national and community capacities for monitoring, control, and participatory management to combat illegal pressures.; Target: Achieve 100% of agroforests, classified forests, and rural domain forests covered by an enhanced monitoring system from 2025-2035.; Baseline: In 2024, approximately 25% of agroforests, classified forests, and rural domain forests in Côte d'Ivoire benefit from an enhanced monitoring system.
textOriginal: Objectif: Préserver l’intégrité des massifs forestiers en améliorant les capacités nationales et communautaires de surveillance, de contrôle et de gestion participative pour lutter contre les pressions illégales.; Cible: Atteindre 100% des agro-forêts, forêts classées et forêts du domaine rural couvert par un dispositif de surveillance renforcée de 2025-2035.; Point de référence: En 2024, environ 25% des agro-forêts, forêts classées et forêts du domaine rural en Côte d'Ivoire bénéficient d'un dispositif de surveillance renforcée

text: Goal: Provide real-time reliable data for monitoring and tracking deforestation; Target: The BIS is 100% operational and covers the entire territory by 2030; Benchmark: By 2025, the BIS is partially operational and covers approximately 40 to 50% of the national territory.
textOriginal: Objectif: Fournir en temps réel des données fiables pour le contrôle et le suivi de la déforestation; Cible: Le SNSF est 100% opérationnel et couvre l’ensemble du territoire avant 2030.; Point de référence: En 2025, le SNSF est partiellement opérationnel et couvre environ 40 à 50 % du territoire national

text: Goal: Eliminate deforestation in agricultural value chains by ensuring traceability and compliance of export products with national and international sustainability standards and commitments.; Target: Achieve 100% "zero-deforestation" traceability for major agricultural export sectors (cocoa, coffee, rubber, palm oil, cashew) from 2025-2035.; Baseline: By 2025, approximately 30% of agricultural export sectors (cocoa, coffee, rubber, palm oil, cashew) have "zero-deforestation" traceability.
textOriginal: Objectif: Éliminer la déforestation dans les chaînes de valeurs agricoles en assurant la traçabilité et la conformité des produits à l'exportation avec les normes et engagements nationaux et internationaux de durabilité.; Cible: Atteindre 100% de traçabilité «zéro-déforestation» pour les principales filières agricoles d'exportation (cacao, café, hévéa palmier à huile, anacarde) de 2025-2035.; Point de référence: En 2025, environ 30% des filières agricoles d'exportation (cacao, café, hévéa, palmier à huile, anacarde) disposent d'une traçabilité «zero-déforestation».

sources.sourceText: Goal: Eliminate deforestation in agricultural value chains by ensuring traceability and compliance of export products with national and international sustainability standards and commitments.; Target: Achieve 100% "zero-deforestation" traceability for major agricultural export sectors (cocoa, coffee, rubber, palm oil, cashew) from 2025-2035.; Baseline: By 2025, approximately 30% of agricultural export sectors (cocoa, coffee, rubber, palm oil, cashew) have "zero-deforestation" traceability.

text: Goal: Improve forest governance and ensure the legality of the harvesting of timber (wood) and non-timber forest products (NTFPs) as well as their further valorization, to meet market requirements and preserve the resource in the long term.; Target: 100% of marketed forest products from verified legal and sustainable sources by 2025-2035; Baseline: In 2025, approximately 50% of marketed forest products come from verified legal and sustainable sources.
textOriginal: Objectif: Améliorer la gouvernance forestière et assurer la légilité de l'exploitation des produits forestiers ligneux (bois) et non ligneux (PFLN) ainsi que leur valorisation plus poussée, pour répondre aux exigences des marchés et préserver la ressource sur le long terme.; Cible: 100% de produits forestiers commercialisés issus de sources légales et durables vérifiées de 2025-2035; Point de référence: En 2025, environ 50 % des produits forestiers commercialisés proviennent de sources légales et durables vérifiées.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Improve forest governance and ensure the legality of the harvesting of timber (wood) and non-timber forest products (NTFPs) as well as their further valorization, to meet market requirements and preserve the resource in the long term.; Target: 100% of marketed forest products from verified legal and sustainable sources by 2025-2035; Baseline: In 2025, approximately 50% of marketed forest products come from verified legal and sustainable sources.

text: Goal: Improve operational capacity for anticipation and intervention to limit the spread of fires and achieve the goal of reducing burned areas, thereby protecting carbon stocks, biological diversity, and the livelihoods of communities.; Target: The national early warning system is 100% operational and covers the entire territory by 2035.; Benchmark: By 2025, the national early warning system is partially operational and covers approximately 40% of the territory.
textOriginal: Objectif: Améliorer la capacité opérationnelle d'anticipation et d'intervention pour limiter la propagation des feux et atteindre l'objectif de réduction des surfaces brûlées, protégeant ainsi les stocks de carbone, la biodiversité et les moyens de subsistance des communautés.; Cible: Le système national d'alerte précoce est 100% opérationnel et couvre l'ensemble du territoire d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2025, le système national d'alerte précoce est partiellement opérationnel et couvre environ 40% du territoire.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Improve operational capacity for anticipation and intervention to limit the spread of fires and achieve the goal of reducing burned areas, thereby protecting carbon stocks, biological diversity, and the livelihoods of communities.; Target: The national early warning system is 100% operational and covers the entire territory by 2035.; Benchmark: By 2025, the national early warning system is partially operational and covers approximately 40% of the territory.

text: Goal: Ensure the availability of quality planting material to achieve national reforestation targets, while creating green jobs and economic opportunities for youth and women.; Target: Achieve an annual production capacity of 40 million high-quality plants, with a participation rate of 60% from businesses led by women or youth from 2025-2035.; Benchmark: In 2025, the annual production capacity is close to 0 high-quality plants.
textOriginal: Objectif: Assurer la disponibilité en matériel végétal de qualité pour atteindre les objectifs nationaux de reboisement, tout en créant des emplois verts et des opportunités économiques pour les jeunes et les femmes.; Cible: Atteindre une capacité de production annuelle de 40 millions de plants de haute qualité, avec un taux de participation de 60% d'entreprises dirigées par des femmes ou des jeunes de 2025-2035.; Point de référence: En 2025, la capacité de production annuelle est proche de 0 plant de haute qualité.

text: Implement integrated water resource management approaches resilient to climate change.
textOriginal: Mettre en œuvre des approches de gestion intégrée des ressources en eau résilientes au changement climatique

sources.sourceText: Implement integrated water resource management approaches resilient to climate change.

text: Goal: Develop circular hydraulic infrastructures to secure supply for populations, preserve ecosystems (including risks related to invasive alien species), and support economic activities in the face of the effects of climate change; Target: Achieve at least 80% coverage of priority areas with sustainable hydraulic infrastructures by 2035; Benchmark: By 2025, approximately 40% of priority areas will benefit from sustainable hydraulic infrastructures ensuring reliable access to water.
textOriginal: Objectif: Développer des infrastructures hydrauliques circulaires afin de sécuriser l'approvisionnement pour les populations, préserver les écosystèmes (en incluant les risques liés aux EEE) et soutenir les activités économiques face aux effets du changement climatique; Cible: Atteindre au moins 80% de couverture des zones prioritaires en infrastructures hydrauliques durables d'ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2025, environ 40% des zones prioritaires bénéficient d'infrastructures hydrauliques durables assurant un accès fiable à l'eau.

sources.sourceText: Goal: Develop circular hydraulic infrastructures to secure supply for populations, preserve ecosystems (including risks related to invasive alien species), and support economic activities in the face of the effects of climate change; Target: Achieve at least 80% coverage of priority areas with sustainable hydraulic infrastructures by 2035; Benchmark: By 2025, approximately 40% of priority areas will benefit from sustainable hydraulic infrastructures ensuring reliable access to water.

text: Goal: Maintain ecosystem services, enhance resilience to climate change, and ensure equitable access to water.; Target: Reduce the rate of degradation of catchment areas and strategic water sources by at least 40% by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, approximately 60% of catchment areas and water sources are affected by forms of degradation (erosion, pollution, uncontrolled urbanization).
textOriginal: Objectif: Maintenir les services écosystémiques, renforcer la résilience au changement climatique et garantir l'accès équitable à l'eau.; Cible: Réduire d'au moins 40% d'ici 2035 le taux de dégradation des zones de captage et des sources d'eau stratégiques; Point de référence: En 2020, environ 60% des zones de captage et des sources d'eau sont affectées par des formes de dégradation (érosion, pollution, urbanisation non maîtrisée).

sources.sourceText: Goal: Maintain ecosystem services, enhance resilience to climate change, and ensure equitable access to water.; Target: Reduce the rate of degradation of catchment areas and strategic water sources by at least 40% by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, approximately 60% of catchment areas and water sources are affected by forms of degradation (erosion, pollution, uncontrolled urbanization).

text: Goal: Improve forecasting, planning, and decision-making in water management and climate resilience; Target: By 2035, 90% of planned hydro-climatic stations must be installed, operational, and integrated into an innovative national data monitoring and dissemination system; Benchmark: In 2023, approximately 20% of existing hydro-climatic stations were operational and connected to a structured data management system.
textOriginal: Objectif: Améliorer la prévision, la planification et la prise de décision en matière de gestion de l'eau et de résilience climatique; Cible: D’ici 2035, 90% des stations hydro-climatiques prévues devront être installées, fonctionnelles et intégrées dans un système national innovant de suivi et de diffusion des données; Point de référence: En 2023, environ 20% des stations hydro-climatiques existantes étaient opérationnelles et connectées à un système structuré de gestion des données

sources.sourceText: Goal: Improve forecasting, planning, and decision-making in water management and climate resilience; Target: By 2035, 90% of planned hydro-climatic stations must be installed, operational, and integrated into an innovative national data monitoring and dissemination system; Benchmark: In 2023, approximately 20% of existing hydro-climatic stations were operational and connected to a structured data management system.

text: Goal: Reduce flood risks and protect infrastructure and populations; Target: Reduce the rate of recurrent flooding or overflow in urban and peri-urban areas equipped with stormwater management devices that meet appropriate technical standards by at least 60% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, priority urban areas record an average of 10 significant flooding events per year, causing substantial damage to infrastructure and populations.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les risques d'inondation et protéger les infrastructures et les populations; Cible: Réduire d'au moins 60% d’ici 2035 le taux d'inondations ou de débordements récurrents dans les zones urbaines et périurbaines équipées de dispositifs de gestion des eaux pluviales conformes aux normes techniques adaptées.; Point de référence: En 2023, les zones urbaines prioritaires enregistrent en moyenne 10 évènements d'inondations significatifs par an, causant des dommages importants aux infrastructures et aux populations

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce flood risks and protect infrastructure and populations; Target: Reduce the rate of recurrent flooding or overflow in urban and peri-urban areas equipped with stormwater management devices that meet appropriate technical standards by at least 60% by 2035; Benchmark: In 2023, priority urban areas record an average of 10 significant flooding events per year, causing substantial damage to infrastructure and populations.

text: Goal: Safeguard infrastructure and ensure the continuity of its operation; Target: Increase by 40% the number of water resources and hydraulic works with land tenure status; Benchmark: In 2023, several hydraulic works are not legally protected and are being invaded by populations and nuisance activities that render them vulnerable, leading to their abandonment and the pollution of surface and groundwater, depriving socio-economic activities and populations of water.
textOriginal: Objectif: Sauvegarder les infrastructures et assurer la continuité de leur exploitation; Cible: Accroître de 40%, le nombre de ressources en eau et d'ouvrages hydrauliques disposant d'un statut foncier; Point de référence: En 2023, plusieurs ouvrages hydrauliques ne sont pas protégés juridiquement et se retrouvent envahis par des populations et des activités de nuisance qui les rendent vulnérables, occasionnant leur abandon et la pollution des eaux de surface et souterraines, la privation en eau des activités socioéconomiques et des populations

sources.sourceText: Goal: Safeguard infrastructure and ensure the continuity of its operation; Target: Increase by 40% the number of water resources and hydraulic works with land tenure status; Benchmark: In 2023, several hydraulic works are not legally protected and are being invaded by populations and nuisance activities that render them vulnerable, leading to their abandonment and the pollution of surface and groundwater, depriving socio-economic activities and populations of water.

text: Goal: Involve users in the management and protection of the resource and mobilization works; Target: By 2035, 50% of the governance bodies for water resource management as provided by the water code are functional; Benchmark: The 2023 water code provides for the establishment of water management bodies at the national level and at the level of river basins.
textOriginal: Objectif: Impliquer les usagers dans la gestion et la protection de la ressource et les ouvrages de mobilisation; Cible: D’ici 2035, 50% des organes de gouvernance de la gestion des ressources en eau prévus par le code de l'eau sont fonctionnels; Point de référence: Le code de l'eau de 2023 prévoit la mise en place d’organes de gestion de l'eau au niveau national et au niveau des bassins hydrographiques

sources.sourceText: Goal: Involve users in the management and protection of the resource and mobilization works; Target: By 2035, 50% of the governance bodies for water resource management as provided by the water code are functional; Benchmark: The 2023 water code provides for the establishment of water management bodies at the national level and at the level of river basins.

text: Strengthen monitoring, prevention, and management systems for climate-sensitive diseases differentiated by gender and age.
textOriginal: Renforcer les systèmes de surveillance, de prévention et de gestion des maladies climato-sensibles différenciées par sexe et par âge

sources.sourceText: Strengthen monitoring, prevention, and management systems for climate-sensitive diseases differentiated by gender and age.

text: Goal: Reduce health risks, morbidity, and mortality associated with emerging and re-emerging diseases in the areas most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change.; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 25% of high vulnerability areas by functional epidemiological surveillance systems that integrate climate risks by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 5% of high vulnerability areas in Côte d'Ivoire have functional epidemiological surveillance systems that integrate climate risks.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les risques sanitaires, la morbidité et la mortalité associées aux maladies émergentes et réémergences dans les zones les plus vulnérables aux impacts du changement climatique.; Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 25% des zones à vulnérabilité élevée par des systèmes de surveillance épidémiologique fonctionnels et intégrant les risques climatiques d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 5% des zones à vulnérabilité élevée en Côte d’Ivoire disposent de systèmes de surveillance épidémiologique fonctionnels intégrant les risques climatiques

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce health risks, morbidity, and mortality associated with emerging and re-emerging diseases in the areas most vulnerable to the impacts of climate change.; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 25% of high vulnerability areas by functional epidemiological surveillance systems that integrate climate risks by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 5% of high vulnerability areas in Côte d'Ivoire have functional epidemiological surveillance systems that integrate climate risks.

text: Goal: Improve equitable access to quality healthcare and ensure continuity of health services; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 25% of health facilities built, rehabilitated, or equipped according to standards of equity, sustainability, and climate resilience by 2035; Baseline: In 2023, approximately 10% of health facilities built, rehabilitated, or equipped according to standards of equity, sustainability, and climate resilience and energy efficiency solutions.
textOriginal: Objectif: Améliorer l'accès équitable à des soins de qualité et assurer la continuité des services de santé; Cible: Atteindre un taux d’au moins 25% d’établissements sanitaires construits, réhabilités ou équipés selon des normesd’équité, de durabilité et de résilience climatique d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2023, environ 10% des établissements sanitaires construits, réhabilités ou équipés selon des normes d’équité, de durabilité et de résilience climatique et des solutions d’efficacité énergétique

sources.sourceText: Goal: Improve equitable access to quality healthcare and ensure continuity of health services; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 25% of health facilities built, rehabilitated, or equipped according to standards of equity, sustainability, and climate resilience by 2035; Baseline: In 2023, approximately 10% of health facilities built, rehabilitated, or equipped according to standards of equity, sustainability, and climate resilience and energy efficiency solutions.

text: Goal: Guide public health policies and climate adaptation strategies; Target: Achieve a utilization rate of at least 50% of available health, climate, and environmental data in the development and updating of the Country Profile by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of available health, climate, and environmental data are effectively integrated and used cross-sectorally in health vulnerability analyses related to climate change.
textOriginal: Objectif: Orienter les politiques de santé publique et les stratégies d’adaptation climatique; Cible: Atteindre un taux d'utilisation d'au moins 50% des données sanitaires, climatiques et environnementales disponibles dans l’élaboration et la mise à jour du Profil Pays d’ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 10 % des données sanitaires, climatiques et environnementales disponibles sont effectivement intégrées et utilisées de manière croisée dans les analyses de vulnérabilité sanitaire liées au changement climatique

sources.sourceText: Goal: Guide public health policies and climate adaptation strategies; Target: Achieve a utilization rate of at least 50% of available health, climate, and environmental data in the development and updating of the Country Profile by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of available health, climate, and environmental data are effectively integrated and used cross-sectorally in health vulnerability analyses related to climate change.

text: Goal: Detect pollution levels in regional hubs, alert populations and authorities in case of exceeding health thresholds; Target: Achieve a continuous availability rate of at least 30% of air quality data in the 10 Regional Health Excellence Hubs by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, none of the 10 Regional Health Excellence Hubs have operational continuous air quality measurement devices.
textOriginal: Objectif: Détecter les niveaux de pollution dans les pôles régionaux, alerter les populations et les autorités en cas de dépassement des seuils sanitaires; Cible: Atteindre un taux de disponibilité continue d'au moins 30% des données sur la qualité de l'air dans les 10 Pôles Régionaux d'Excellence Sanitaire (PRES) d'ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, aucun des 10 Pôles Régionaux d'Excellence Sanitaire (PRES) ne dispose de dispositifs opérationnels de mesure continue de la qualité de l'air,

sources.sourceText: Goal: Detect pollution levels in regional hubs, alert populations and authorities in case of exceeding health thresholds; Target: Achieve a continuous availability rate of at least 30% of air quality data in the 10 Regional Health Excellence Hubs by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, none of the 10 Regional Health Excellence Hubs have operational continuous air quality measurement devices.

text: Strengthen the establishment of resilient and sustainable health facilities.
textOriginal: Renforcer la mise en place des établissements sanitaires résilients et durables.

sources.sourceText: Strengthen the establishment of resilient and sustainable health facilities.

text: Goal: Ensure the continuity and security of health services, protect patients and staff from climate risks, and ensure sustainable infrastructure that is adapted to current and future environmental challenges, including the closing of resource flows (energy, water, materials, waste); Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 50% of priority health centers through rehabilitation interventions that meet resilient construction standards by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 25% of priority health centers in Côte d'Ivoire have rehabilitated infrastructure that is resilient to climate change.
textOriginal: Objectif: Garantir la continuité et la sécurité des services de santé, protéger les patient.e.s et le personnel contre les risques climatiques, et assurer des infrastructures durables et adaptées aux défis environnementaux actuels et futurs incluant le bouclage des flux de ressources (énergie, eau, matériaux, déchets); Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 50% des centres de santé prioritaires par des interventions de réhabilitation respectant les normes de construction résiliente d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 25% des centres de santé prioritaires en Côte d'Ivoire disposent d'infrastructures réhabilitées et résilientes au changement climatique

sources.sourceText: Goal: Ensure the continuity and security of health services, protect patients and staff from climate risks, and ensure sustainable infrastructure that is adapted to current and future environmental challenges, including the closing of resource flows (energy, water, materials, waste); Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 50% of priority health centers through rehabilitation interventions that meet resilient construction standards by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 25% of priority health centers in Côte d'Ivoire have rehabilitated infrastructure that is resilient to climate change.

text: Goal: Strengthen their resilience to power outages and reduce their carbon footprint.; Target: Achieve at least 50% of health facilities with partial or total energy autonomy through renewable energy sources (solar, biomass) by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 15% of health facilities in Côte d'Ivoire have an operational renewable energy source.
textOriginal: Objectif: Renforcer leur résilience face aux coupures d'électricité et réduire leur empreinte carbone.; Cible: Atteindre au moins 50% d'établissements sanitaires disposant d'une autonomie énergétique partielle ou totale grâce à des sources d'énergies renouvelables (solaire, biomasse) d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 15% des établissements sanitaires en Côte d'Ivoire disposent d'une source d'énergie renouvelable opérationnelle

sources.sourceText: Goal: Strengthen their resilience to power outages and reduce their carbon footprint.; Target: Achieve at least 50% of health facilities with partial or total energy autonomy through renewable energy sources (solar, biomass) by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 15% of health facilities in Côte d'Ivoire have an operational renewable energy source.

text: Goal: Reduce health and environmental risks associated with healthcare waste; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 80% of healthcare facilities with a biomedical waste management system that complies with environmental and health standards by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 30% of healthcare facilities in Côte d'Ivoire have a structured and compliant system for biomedical waste management.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire les risques sanitaires et environnementaux liés aux déchets sanitaires; Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 80% des établissements sanitaires par un système de gestion des déchets biomédicaux conforme aux normes environnementales et sanitaires d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 30% des établissements sanitaires en Côte d'Ivoire disposent d'un système structuré et conforme aux normes pour la gestion des déchets biomédicaux,

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce health and environmental risks associated with healthcare waste; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 80% of healthcare facilities with a biomedical waste management system that complies with environmental and health standards by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 30% of healthcare facilities in Côte d'Ivoire have a structured and compliant system for biomedical waste management.

text: Implement ecosystem restoration solutions for mangroves, defense structures, and early warning mechanisms in vulnerable coastal areas.
textOriginal: Mettre en œuvre des solutions de restauration des mangroves, des ouvrages de défense et des mécanismes d'alerte précoce, dans les zones côtières vulnérables

sources.sourceText: Implement ecosystem restoration solutions for mangroves, defense structures, and early warning mechanisms in vulnerable coastal areas.

text: Goal: To have the capacity to prevent risks, anticipate disasters, and strengthen the resilience of ecosystems and coastal men and women; Target: To achieve a coverage rate of at least 90% of the Ivorian coastline by operational monitoring and alert systems for climate risks and extreme events by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 25% of the Ivorian coastline is covered by functional climate monitoring and alert systems.
textOriginal: Objectif: Disposer de capacités pour prévenir les risques, anticiper les catastrophes et renforcer la résilience des écosystèmes et des hommes et femmes du littoral; Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 90% du littoral ivoirien par des dispositifs opérationnels de surveillance et d'alerte face aux risques climatiques et évènements extrêmes d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 25% du littoral ivoirien est couvert par des dispositifs fonctionnels de surveillance et d'alerte climatique

sources.sourceText: Goal: To have the capacity to prevent risks, anticipate disasters, and strengthen the resilience of ecosystems and coastal men and women; Target: To achieve a coverage rate of at least 90% of the Ivorian coastline by operational monitoring and alert systems for climate risks and extreme events by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 25% of the Ivorian coastline is covered by functional climate monitoring and alert systems.

text: Goal: Protect, restore, and enhance the resilience of coastal ecosystems threatened by erosion, marine submersion, salinization, and the proliferation of invasive alien species, by combining nature-based solutions and appropriate gray infrastructure.; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 35% of targeted vulnerable coastal areas adopting nature-based solutions and circulation to combat climate risks and invasive alien species by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of vulnerable coastal areas in Côte d'Ivoire had implemented enhanced protection measures.
textOriginal: Objectif: Protéger, restaurer et renforcer la résilience des écosystèmes côtiers menacés par l'érosion, les submersions marines, la salinisation et la prolifération d'espèces envahissantes, en combinant les solutions fondées sur la nature (SbN) et les infrastructures grises adaptées.; Cible: Atteindre un taux d'au moins 35% des zones côtières vulnérables ciblées ayant adopté des solutions fondées sur la nature et la circulation pour lutter contre les risques climatiques et les espèces exotiques envahissantes d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 10% des zones côtières vulnérables en Côte d'Ivoire ont mis en œuvre des mesures de protection renforcées

sources.sourceText: Goal: Protect, restore, and enhance the resilience of coastal ecosystems threatened by erosion, marine submersion, salinization, and the proliferation of invasive alien species, by combining nature-based solutions and appropriate gray infrastructure.; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 35% of targeted vulnerable coastal areas adopting nature-based solutions and circulation to combat climate risks and invasive alien species by 2035.; Baseline: In 2020, less than 10% of vulnerable coastal areas in Côte d'Ivoire had implemented enhanced protection measures.

text: Goal: Preserve marine biodiversity and resources to enhance the resilience of coastal ecosystems against human and climate pressures.; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 30% of sensitive marine areas by functional and sustainably managed Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 10% of sensitive marine areas in Côte d'Ivoire are covered by operational Marine Protected Areas (MPAs).
textOriginal: Objectif: Préserver la biodiversité marine et les ressources afin de renforcer la résilience des écosystèmes côtiers face aux pressions humaines et climatiques.; Cible: Atteindre un taux de couverture d'au moins 30% des zones marines sensibles par des Aires Marines Protégées (AMP) fonctionnelles et durablement gérées d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 10% des zones marines sensibles en Côte d'Ivoire sont couvertes par des Aires Marines Protégées (AMP) opérationnelles

sources.sourceText: Goal: Preserve marine biodiversity and resources to enhance the resilience of coastal ecosystems against human and climate pressures.; Target: Achieve a coverage rate of at least 30% of sensitive marine areas by functional and sustainably managed Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 10% of sensitive marine areas in Côte d'Ivoire are covered by operational Marine Protected Areas (MPAs).

text: Goal: Preserve the ecological functions of wetlands by ensuring their protection, restoration, and sustainable management, in accordance with the commitments of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance; Target: Achieve an effective implementation rate of at least 60% of the measures outlined in the management plans of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance sites by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 30% of the measures outlined in the management plans of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance sites in Côte d'Ivoire are effectively implemented.
textOriginal: Objectif: Préserver les fonctions écologiques des zones humides en assurant leur protection, leur restauration et leur gestion durable, conformément aux engagements de la Convention de Ramsar; Cible: Atteindre un taux d'au moins 60% de mise en œuvre effective des mesures prévues dans les plans de gestion des sites RAMSAR d'ici 2035; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 30% des mesures prévues dans les plans de gestion des sites RAMSAR en Côte d'Ivoire sont effectivement mises en œuvre

sources.sourceText: Goal: Preserve the ecological functions of wetlands by ensuring their protection, restoration, and sustainable management, in accordance with the commitments of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance; Target: Achieve an effective implementation rate of at least 60% of the measures outlined in the management plans of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance sites by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, less than 30% of the measures outlined in the management plans of the Convention on Wetlands of International Importance sites in Côte d'Ivoire are effectively implemented.

text: Promote a sustainable blue economy
textOriginal: Promouvoir une Economie bleue durable

sources.sourceText: Promote a sustainable blue economy

text: Goal: Reduce the pressure on natural fishery resources by developing sustainable aquaculture based on ecological freshwater fish farming and mariculture; Target: Increase the pressure on wild fish stocks by at least 40% by 2035, through the development of sustainable aquaculture (freshwater fish farming and mariculture) as an alternative to overfishing; Baseline: In 2020, less than 5.5% of the national fish production in Côte d'Ivoire comes from aquaculture production.
textOriginal: Objectif: Réduire la pression sur les ressources halieutiques naturelles en développant une aquaculture durable fondée sur la pisciculture continentale et la mariculture écologiques; Cible: Augmenter d'au moins 40% d'ici 2035 la pression exercée sur les stocks halieutiques sauvages, grâce au développement de l'aquaculture durable (pisciculture continentale et mariculture) comme alternative à la surpêche.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 5.5% de la production nationale de poisson en Côte d'Ivoire provient de la production aquacole

sources.sourceText: Goal: Reduce the pressure on natural fishery resources by developing sustainable aquaculture based on ecological freshwater fish farming and mariculture; Target: Increase the pressure on wild fish stocks by at least 40% by 2035, through the development of sustainable aquaculture (freshwater fish farming and mariculture) as an alternative to overfishing; Baseline: In 2020, less than 5.5% of the national fish production in Côte d'Ivoire comes from aquaculture production.

text: Goal: Strengthen the sustainability of port infrastructures for an ecological and just transition.; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 70% of sustainable port infrastructures by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 30% of port infrastructures are sustainable.
textOriginal: Objectif: Renforcer la durabilité des infrastructures portuaires pour une transition écologique et juste.; Cible: Atteindre un taux d'au moins 70% des infrastructures portuaires durables d'ici 2035.; Point de référence: En 2020, moins de 30% des infrastructures portuaires sont durables

sources.sourceText: Goal: Strengthen the sustainability of port infrastructures for an ecological and just transition.; Target: Achieve a rate of at least 70% of sustainable port infrastructures by 2035.; Benchmark: In 2020, less than 30% of port infrastructures are sustainable.

text: Goal: Increase the livelihoods of communities in a sustainable perspective; Target: Raise the contribution of sustainable blue activities owned by men and women (ecotourism, sustainable fishing, ecological aquaculture, marine energies) to local community income in coastal areas to at least 25% by 2035; Baseline: In 2020, the contribution of sustainable blue activities to local community income in the coastal areas of Côte d'Ivoire is estimated to be less than 10%.

text: The extinction of identified threatened species is reduced, and their recovery is strengthened through effective management measures;  This outcome is a proactive response to the species extinction crisis. It aims not only to prevent species loss but also to promote their recovery by focusing on the protection of their natural habitats and reducing threats to their populations, with a commitment to achieving results by 2030. Thus, the objective focuses on preventing the extinction of endangered species by implementing targeted actions to limit biodiversity loss. Here, the goal is not only to prevent extinction but also to encourage the recovery of threatened species’ populations by improving their conservation status. To this end, it is crucial to protect the natural habitats of identified species, as habitat degradation is often one of the main causes of their decline. The objective includes reducing human or environmental pressures that threaten species’ survival (land-use change, pollution, unsustainable exploitation, etc.). Finally, it is part of a long-term approach, with a target date of 2030, to assess and measure progress made in the conservation of threatened species.

The goal is to create cities that are resilient to climate change, while improving the quality of life for local residents, protecting biodiversity, and ensuring the sustainable use of natural resources.

Il encourage les autorités locales à adopter des stratégies de croissance verte (favorisant les énergies renouvelables, l’efficacité énergétique, et les infrastructures durables) et de croissance bleue (mettant l’accent sur la protection et la gestion durable des ressources marines et aquatiques). text: 10% of the national territory benefits from integrated spatial planning for terrestrial and aquatic environments;  The goal is to ensure the participatory planning, establishment, and management of protected areas in Côte d'Ivoire, making sure they cover all types of ecosystems present in the country. This will be achieved by actively involving local communities in decision-making processes, respecting their rights, and incorporating their traditional knowledge. This initiative is in line with international commitments, notably those of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, which aims to incorporate all types of ecosystems into participatory spatial planning and the effective management of critical areas (Target 1) in order to protect 30% of land and seas by 2030 (Target 3). The initiative helps preserve biodiversity while promoting inclusive governance and the equitable sharing of conservation benefits. In doing so, Côte d’Ivoire is committed not only to protecting its ecosystems and biodiversity but also to supporting the livelihoods of local communities, ensuring that conservation is an equitable process that benefits everyone.

Cet effet s'inscrit dans le cadre des engagements pris au niveau international, notamment ceux du cadre mondial de la biodiversité de Kunming-Montréal, qui vise la prise en compte de toutes types d’écosystème dans la planification spatiale qui se veut participative et à la gestion efficace des zones critique (Cible 1) à l’effet de protéger 30 % des terres et des mers d'ici 2030 (Cible 3). L'initiative contribue à préserver la biodiversité tout en promouvant une gouvernance inclusive et une répartition équitable des bénéfices liés à la conservation. Ce faisant, la Côte d'Ivoire s'engage non seulement à protéger ses écosystèmes et sa biodiversité, mais aussi à soutenir les moyens de subsistance des communautés locales, en veillant à ce que la conservation soit un processus équitable et bénéfique pour tous.

text: Various forms of pollution are reduced by at least 10%, thereby limiting their impacts on ecosystems and human health; this ambitious and holistic approach aims to significantly reduce pollution, protect sensitive ecosystems and human health, while minimizing both the causes and the impacts. It is based on an integrated approach to environmental management, promoting the prevention of negative effects and adopting sustainable solutions. The emphasis on measurable pollution reduction and the protection of vulnerable areas makes it a key objective for environmental resilience and sustainability. By setting a quantified target of 30%, it allows for the assessment of concrete progress. Pollution reduction efforts can be monitored and adjusted based on data, ensuring rigorous tracking of results. In addition to reduction, this goal emphasizes the prevention of pollution’s impacts, particularly on sensitive ecosystems and human health. This reflects a preventive rather than a curative approach, aimed at limiting risks before they become too severe.

Cela reflète une approche préventive plutôt que curative, visant à limiter les risques avant qu’ils ne deviennent trop graves.
